'''Klubi Futbollistik Malisheva''' ({{Translation|Football Club Malisheva}}), commonly known as '''Malisheva''', is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Malisheva]], [[Kosovo]]. Their home ground is Liman Gegaj Stadium which has a seating capacity of 1,800. The club plays in the [[Football Superleague of Kosovo|Kosovo Superleague]], which is the top tier of football in the country."}}
